issues.detail: The conversation requests 360 proposed items. 165 existing progression entries are identifiable; the complete named 360-item proposal is not present in the inspected repository or the supplied conversation. Missing count is a reconciliation gap, not proof existing entries belong to that proposal.
Current merchant generation uses 40% with a minimum one unit in the displayed denomination, and some fixed offers use other ratios. v1 requires 25%. No runtime values changed.
Current fixed/featured offers do not implement exactly three mixed-rarity items per category or the approved 24-hour stock selection.
Purchase-level thresholds and trader tier assignments are not specified. Crafting levels are not equivalent to purchase eligibility.
24-hour duration is approved. Epoch/timezone, shared versus per-player rotation, stock quantities, rarity distribution and restart behavior need review.
25% sell-back and percentage discounts can produce fractions of one copper. Rounding policy and payout basis (base/current/paid price) are unspecified.
Existing helper computes a fixed approximately 25% discount with denomination rounding. That is within 15–40%, but does not implement the full approved range/distribution or duration.

Mixed-rarity general-store stock must respect the earlier restriction: Legendary/Mythic/Unique only via Flash Deals, dangerous exploration or bosses. Ordinary general/specialist stock must exclude these unless owner changes the restriction.
Existing regional stock pricing varies from 75% to 150% of base; confirm its interaction with 25% sell-back and Flash Deals. Prevent buy/sell arbitrage.

Cash Store is currently unavailable. Cosmetics-only policy is approved; no real-money prices, payment provider or purchasable SKU list has been specified. Gameplay supply bundles/deeds/coins must not become cash purchases.
